description: This file defines a React component for a static, always-visible sidebar used for primary navigation in a web application. It includes a utility function to clear client-side authentication artifacts and a Sidebar component that renders navigation links and a logout button, handling user logout by clearing tokens and navigating to the login page.

methods.name: clearClientAuthArtifacts
methods.description: Utility function to clear authentication and session tokens from localStorage and sessionStorage, with optional extra keys.
